button.saxophone.toggle.avarice.tooltip: Enable/disable model rendering and name change for Avarice, as well as other features...
button.saxophone.toggle.eos.tooltip: Enable/disable model rendering and name change for Eos, as well as other features...
button.saxophone.toggle.flair.tooltip: Enable/disable a custom username style set for contributors...
button.saxophone.toggle.fx.tooltip: Enable/disable custom effects, usually core shaders, for contributors' player models...
button.saxophone.toggle.invincibility.to: Prevent damage to Avarice, but likewise prevent Avarice from inflicting damage...
button.saxophone.toggle.invisibility.too: Enable/disable rendering of Avarice, as well as particles, shadow, and footsteps...
button.saxophone.toggle.shield_avarice.t: Enable/disable protection for Avarice, should Eos deem it worthy...
button.saxophone.toggle.transparency.too: Enable/disable a transparent shader for Avarice...
button.saxophone.toggle.wavering.tooltip: Enable/disable a wavering text style for the player name (and sometimes speech)...

death.attack.cleanse.player: %1$s had their soul cleansed of sin
